# AI Knowledge Map

> Explore Artificial Intelligence visually. A free, interactive knowledge map of AI concepts, techniques, tools, ethics, and governance — for students, researchers, and professionals.

AI Knowledge Map is a static, multilingual, open educational project built with D3.js. It presents the artificial intelligence landscape — from foundational concepts and techniques to tools, ethics, governance, and risk management — as an interactive visual map. Content is available in English, Brazilian Portuguese, and Spanish.

## Links
- [English](https://aiknowledgemap.org/)
- [Brazilian Portuguese](https://aiknowledgemap.org/pt-br/)
- [Spanish](https://aiknowledgemap.org/es/)
